statusText: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. Tail is elevated because the first cash hour has produced a sharp downside extension with NDX holding near its session low, while a repeated failed-retracement sequence is not yet verified.
recommendation: Current Tail is 32%. The mapped policy state is orange; continuation risk is concentrated through 15:00 UTC and would ease if a substantive rebound and two-sided repair emerge.
headline: Elevated Tail as the cash open extends lower and NDX holds near the session low
body: NDX traded at 29,454.62 after opening at 29,645.18, only about 40 points above the 29,414.33 session low at the assessment cutoff. Related September Nasdaq futures were near 29,484, close to the earlier futures low. Oil, volatility and broad-index weakness amplify Stress, while positive chip-specific catalysts keep cross-asset confirmation incomplete. Shared Finviz context was older than 90 minutes and was excluded from current supporting evidence.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 UTC clock-hour slots, published ChatGPT Tail ranged from 17% to 27% while Stress remained at 100%. A brief 08:00 UTC elevation reverted to WATCH and low Tail before the current cash-open downside extension.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is elevated at 32% during the first cash hour. The danger window runs through 15:00 UTC; Tail is forecast to remain elevated at 15:00 only if the opening decline stays unrepaired and another extension follows a shallow or failed rebound. Substantive two-sided repair would move the base case back toward WATCH and low bands.

forecast.analysis: The cash session has opened with a sharp downside extension: NDX is 29,454.62 after a 29,645.18 open and is only about 40 points above the 29,414.33 session low. That observed lower-range hold raises Tail, while a repeated failed-retracement sequence is not yet verified.
